title: The defining exceptional coefficient transpose has its specified chart equation
statement: Under the standing smooth pure-dimensional finite-type field hypotheses and a finite ell-primary coefficient map A to B, fix intrinsic constructible compact-support adjunctions, their counit-preserving ordinary-etale realizations [def-sp-reduction-exceptional-realization-objects], and the natural coefficient transpose c satisfying its defining counit equation with the actual reductionDirectImageComparison. If that coefficient comparison is invertible on the A-right outputs, then ReductionExceptionalChartEquation holds: there is a site-normalized ordinary input-origin scalar isomorphism, and for every common annihilator, every normalized P1 datum and sum-extension normalization, every admissible open coordinate chart identifies the restricted c with the canonical ordered Tate scalar reassociation. This asserts the chart formula, without claiming global invertibility or constructing either adjunction.

source.place: Charts and Locality paragraphs, retained Steps 5--12

proof.text: Use the bounded-below site Hom bijection followed by the intrinsic derived equivalence. This makes reductionSite fully faithful on D-plus. Scalar extension preserves the finite-Tor constructible origins. Fully faithful cancellation of the specified site scalar/origin isomorphism constructs o, and map_preimage proves its site normalization.

For each common annihilator ell^n, its image is invertible on Y because ell is nonzero in k. Lift the given intrinsic component to a single ordinary morphism q by the site Hom bijection into the bounded-below B right output.
Descend the intrinsic counit identity for this q, then apply the ordinary single-input chart transpose calculation to RA.origin(K), RB.origin(K_B) and o_K.

The generic proved transfer_chart lemma pastes the ordinary chart equation through site/pullback naturality and the scalar/site/pullback cube. Cancelling the right-output isomorphisms gives exactly the specified reductionIntrinsicChartIso equation.

proof_origin.place: Locality and Charts; explicit origin-isomorphism construction, pointwise ordinary lifting, counit descent, ordinary chart calculation, and proved categorical pasting

theorem reductionExceptional_chartEquation
    (ℓ pchar : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hp : 0 < pchar) (hℓ : pchar ≠ ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k pchar]
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p] [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (hf : j ≫ p = f)
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0)
    (hB : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : B, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0) (φ : A →+* B)
    (hFA : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Y A ((reductionCompactSupport A j p).obj M.obj))
    (hFB : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X B,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Y B ((reductionCompactSupport B j p).obj M.obj))
    (hSX : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor X B ((scalarExtensionFunctor φ X).obj M.obj))
    (hSY : ∀ K : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y A,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Y B ((scalarExtensionFunctor φ Y).obj K.obj))
    (GA : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y A ⥤ spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A)
    (GB : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y B ⥤ spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X B)
    (adjA : reductionCtfCompactSupport A j p hFA ⊣ GA)
    (adjB : reductionCtfCompactSupport B j p hFB ⊣ GB)
    (RA : ReductionExceptionalRealization A j p hFA GA adjA)
    (RB : ReductionExceptionalRealization B j p hFB GB adjB)
    (c : GA ⋙ reductionCtfScalar φ X hSX ⟶ reductionCtfScalar φ Y hSY ⋙ GB)
    (hb : ∀ K : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y A,
      IsIso ((reductionDirectImageComparison φ j p).app (GA.obj K).obj))
    (hc : ∀ K : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y A,
      (reductionCompactSupport B j p).map (c.app K).hom ≫
          (adjB.counit.app ((reductionCtfScalar φ Y hSY).obj K)).hom =
        @inv _ _ _ _ ((reductionDirectImageComparison φ j p).app (GA.obj K).obj)
            (hb K) ≫
          (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Y).map (adjA.counit.app K).hom) :
    ReductionExceptionalChartEquation ℓ φ j p d hFA hFB hSX hSY GA GB adjA adjB RA RB c
